The setting is modern and technological, with a futuristic design. In the center of the image, there is a white toy swan with an orange beak and feet, floating in zero gravity. This toy is labeled as "Joy," and it is described as "the fifth crew member" on Ax-4. The toy swan is positioned near a circular light fixture, which adds to the futuristic ambiance
